title: P5-03: Template: p.apyr.us subdomain, staging host and apex apyr.us redirect in site.json
description:
## Goal
`infra/site.json` for a Pretext site can put the CMS app on the subdomain `p.apyr.us` (zone `apyr.us`, Z10285921B1G7MVRV06W9), add an explicit staging host, and redirect the apex `apyr.us` to `https://p.apyr.us` permanently with the path preserved, without touching the existing MX record for p.apyr.us.

## Context (FACT)
- Today `apyr.us` is a domain association on old app dbsyytcm9drqa with subdomains `p` (main) and the apex (main, unverified). Route 53 zone records: apex A alias to CloudFront, `p.apyr.us` A alias plus MX `10 inbound-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com`, one ACM validation CNAME.
- apex redirect is an Amplify app rule `https://apyr.us` -> `https://p.apyr.us` status 302 (path preserved: `apyr.us/2026/october/07` -> `p.apyr.us/2026/october/07`). `www.apyr.us` does not resolve.
- Template (`infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/amplify-app-shell.ts`): `cms.domainName` -> one `CfnDomain` with `prefix ""` on `main`; `cms.stagingDomainName` exists; the only app `customRules` is `/<*>` -> `/index.html` 404-200. No redirect option. `newsroom.pilobol.us` proves a subdomain as `cms.domainName`.
- TI P4-05 (PPY-4f2519) already plans "host under a shared root domain and an explicit staging host". Reuse it; do not duplicate.

## Exact steps
1. Gherkin: "site.json with cms.redirects [{from: apyr.us, to: https://p.apyr.us, status: 301}] synthesizes the Amplify redirect rule and keeps the 404 catch-all last", "a subdomain domainName in a parent zone synthesizes", "unknown redirect keys are rejected".
2. Add `cms.redirects` (list of `{ source, target, status }`, 301 or 302) to `site-config.ts` validation and to `customRules` ahead of the 404-200 rule.
3. Check with `cdk diff`/`synth` (no deploy) that no record named `p.apyr.us` of type MX is created or removed by the template.
4. Document in docs/site-hosting.md (custom domains section).

## Acceptance checks
- `npm test` for the template green; `papyrus-infra synth` for a sample p.apyr.us `site.json` shows CfnDomain for `p.apyr.us`, the staging domain, and a rules list ordered `[apex redirect, 404-200 catch-all]`.
- Sample `site.json` validates; invalid status rejected.

## Rollback
Revert; the field is optional.

## Risks
Amplify rule for an apex source on a branch-attached domain (the old app does it today, so supported); MX/alias interaction is verified at cutover (P5-11).

## Needs Ryan
PR merge.

comments.text: Merged Papyrus#151. Added optional `cms.redirects` ([{source,status 301|302}], requires `cms.domainPrefix`) and `examples/p-apyr-us.site.json` (root apyr.us, prefix p, staging prefix p-staging, apex 301). Synth proves: one Domain for apyr.us with main/p, main/"" and staging/p-staging; app rules [apex redirect, 404-200]; no Route 53 records created (MX untouched). NOT provable by synth, left for P5-11: path+query preservation, apex+prefix association on the new app, old app dbsyytcm9drqa releasing apyr.us first. Leaving open for that.
